PEOPLE PLEASER Jeep Cherokee helped lead Four-Wheel Drive into more refined territory. For 2026, it
®
takes it to another level with an interior that delivers the ultimate in relaxation and convenience. Highlights
include available cloth or leatherette seats that feature embossed or perforated designs, along with available
heat and ventilation. A modern-design, premium-wrapped steering wheel offers mounted audio and cruise
controls, available heat, and a view of the 10.25-inch digital, full-color Driver Information Display (DID).
The standard Uconnect® 5 system with available Navigation, an intuitive 12.3-inch touchscreen display and
configurable screen allows for hands-free8 talk and text, and transitions easily to your preferred phone
through wireless Apple CarPlay®9 or Android Auto.™10 Find clever storage solutions in the front floor console,
under the cargo area load floor and in all four door pockets—plus, there's an available wireless charging pad
under the console lid.
